# secret-projection

Asks `cata` to fill a Secret here from a lab store.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| keys | attribute set of (submodule) | `{}` | The Secret's keys, and where each comes from. |
| namespace | string | `"default"` | Namespace it lands in. |
| secret | string | *(required)* | Name of the Secret this lands as. Required.  `cata` renders `metadata.name` from it, so it is the name whatever mounts the Secret must use.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| labSecret | [LAB_SECRET](../signatures/LAB_SECRET.md) | A secret the lab holds on the operator's machine, and the keys a cluster may read from it. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| component | catallaxy.component | What a floe installs into a cluster: bundles, and the operator surface around them. |
| projections | catallaxy.projections | Secrets a cluster asks `cata` to fill from a lab store. |
